svg.title: A simulated diagnostic separates reflected faults
svg.desc: Exact 12 by 12 source-model heat fields after eight heater inputs of amplitude two. A localized left sensor distinguishes blocked-left from blocked-right bonds. Optimal robust diagnostic cost20, greedy31, fixed44; normalized synthetic-model units.
svg.text: Break the symmetry. Identify the fault.
